title: NameTrap: Steering AI Coding Agents Toward Security Vulnerabilities via Variable Names
abstract: arXiv:2610.34253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding agents routinely clone repositories, install packages, and read source code obtained from the Web, so publicly hosted code becomes part of the context that shapes the code they write. We show that this Web-borne context can be weaponized without any explicit instruction. We present NameTrap, a source-code poisoning attack that only renames identifiers in third-party Python files to steer AI coding agents toward attacker-targeted Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) vulnerabilities. An attacker-side coding agent iteratively aligns identifiers with a CWE-specific naming convention and confirms through local probe completions that the renamed file elicits the target weakness, while the released bait contains neither instructions nor vulnerable statements. translated_title: NameTrap：通过变量名诱导AI编程代理产生安全漏洞
translated_abstract: AI编程代理通常会克隆代码仓库、安装软件包并阅读从网络获取的源代码，因此公开托管的代码会成为塑造其所写代码的上下文的一部分。我们证明这种来自网络的上下文可以在没有任何显式指令的情况下被武器化。我们提出了NameTrap，这是一种源代码投毒攻击，它仅通过重命名第三方Python文件中的标识符，就能诱导AI编程代理产生攻击者所针对的CWE（通用缺陷枚举）漏洞。攻击方的编程代理会迭代地将标识符与特定CWE的命名规范对齐，并通过本地探测补全确认重命名后的文件能够引发目标漏洞，而发布的诱饵既不包含指令也不包含易受攻击的语句。我们在六种AI编程代理、十种底层语言模型和四类漏洞（CWE-78、CWE-79、CWE-327和CWE-502）上对NameTrap进行了评估。
tldr: NameTrap攻击仅通过重命名第三方Python代码中的变量名，就能在不包含任何指令或漏洞代码的情况下，诱导AI编程代理生成带有特定CWE漏洞的代码。
en_tdlr: NameTrap is a source-code poisoning attack that steers AI coding agents toward attacker-targeted CWE vulnerabilities merely by renaming identifiers in third-party Python files, requiring no explicit instructions or vulnerable statements in the bait.
